decisions.reason: This safety shoe line sits in the firm's core business and gained its own page by 2024, signalling investment and public commitment that management will be inclined to defend.

The comfort insole has only limited website prominence, so it is easier to cut than the shoe lines, but as a recent add-on to the firm's footwear system management is still somewhat likely to persist with it.
The supportive insole also looks like a lower-commitment accessory, yet it complements the firm's broader foot-health offering and two years on the market still supports continued commitment.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had a dedicated page in both years and fits the firm's innovation narrative closely, making withdrawal unlikely because it would openly contradict prior commitments.
The firefighter and rescue boots moved from a mention to a dedicated page, indicating rising commitment and a willingness to stay the course despite the niche segment.

The moulded insole has been featured on the home page in both years and is backed by a concrete customer-use example, so management has both visible commitment and confirmatory evidence to justify keeping it.
